comment: The Passwall Node upgrade policy: which releases this panel may offer as an upgrade target, and along which verified paths. Read by NEW code only; older PSP builds keep reading docs/compat/v<major>.json, which this file does not replace or restate. revision is a monotonic publication counter: a higher number supersedes a lower one, and a lower one is refused rather than applied. See docs/release-catalog-redesign-plan.md.

applies_to_psp.comment: The PSP versions this revision was reviewed for. A build outside this range must not apply it. This is separate from the FIRST segment of a product version, which is a release line and not a compatibility major.

releases.comment: The newest reviewed release at the time of writing. Evidence names come from the compat verification plan; a release with no evidence is not an upgrade target.
Superseded by beta11, which fixes a panic on a host report with no network section. Still a valid target for a node already on it.

upgrade_edges.comment: An edge is a claim about a PATH, reviewed as such. A release being in range is not the same as a path to it having been checked, which is why the two are separate lists.

refusals.reason: Predates the reviewed registry, never reviewed, long superseded.
